normalization_order: strict UTF-8 parse with duplicate-key rejection
NFC normalize every key and string
reject: more or fewer than one trailing LF

compiler.candidate_generation: the four compiled views never create additional semantic candidates; candidate identity remains canonical atom_id
compiler.deduplication: resolve aliases first, deduplicate by canonical atom_id, and retain one atom only
compiler.direct_closure_rule: each view contains exactly one edge and no view or group metadata may encode a target, route plan, preparation set, action sequence, terminal action, proof, status, provenance, confidence, or solution closure
compiler.eligibility: latest append-only status at the sealed snapshot is SUPPORTED; PROPOSED, PROVISIONAL, CONTRADICTED, REVOKED, terminal/evaluation descendants, and control-tainted products emit no authentic positive view

input_order.age_band: OLD when first SUPPORTED in a predecessor snapshot; NEW when first SUPPORTED in the current snapshot
input_order.round_robin: emit one atom from each nonempty bucket in bucket_order, repeat from the first bucket, and skip exhausted buckets
input_order.suffix_noninterference: adding later events/statuses creates a new snapshot and cannot change any prior bucket, atom order, view bytes, corpus bytes, or digest

compiler.output_cardinality: exactly four views per eligible deduplicated atom, one of each named kind, with no repetitions
compiler.training_exposure: compiler exposure is one per view; any later training repeat belongs to a separately frozen recipe and adds no epistemic support

d0_scope.meaning_of_green: deterministic compiler and intervention-checker conformance only

node_token.escaping: none; every kind and value is restricted to the schema ASCII alphabet

adjacent_length_bin_merge.attempt_order: for an underivable stratum, try the immediately lower answer-token-length bin first, then the immediately higher bin; endpoints have one neighbor
adjacent_length_bin_merge.limit: one adjacent merge per original stratum; no relation, claim-type, status, root-count, provenance-count, candidate-count, or nonadjacent length merge
adjacent_length_bin_merge.on_failure: invalidate the generator/control fixture before model calls

s_bind.answer_marginals: objects are permuted, never invented or dropped; the multiset of object NodeRefs and every rendered completion is preserved within each final stratum
application: freeze and hash the authentic eligible atom set, aliases, root projections, four views, candidate membership, answer slots, return fixtures, corpus manifest, and training envelope
form exact strata and compute one source-claim to donor-claim permutation
replace each source atom object with its donor atom object and keep the source subject and relation
require before_object != after_object and recompute rebound atom_id from the rebound semantic atom
rewrite every alias target to the corresponding rebound atom_id
apply the same claim binding map to control root semantic projections, all four co-referent views, candidate/query membership, answer slots, read returns, corpus entries, and manifests
keep authentic roots, authentic lifecycle logs, and authentic snapshots byte-unchanged
mark every derived product CONTROL_CORRUPTED_S_BIND and NOT_A_LIFECYCLE_CLAIM
s_bind.global_coherence: the binding map is created once at canonical-claim level; no view, alias, root projection, query, answer, return, or manifest may choose or infer its own permutation
s_bind.identity: rebound_atom_id is a new semantic atom identity; source_atom_id, donor_atom_id, proposal_id, status_event_id, alias_id, view_id, and training-realization IDs remain distinct

permutation_algorithm.fixed_point_rule: both donor_atom_id != source_atom_id and donor.object != source.object for every source
permutation_algorithm.method: sort source claims by atom_id; choose the numerically smallest cyclic left shift k in 1..n-1 satisfying the fixed-point rule for every row
permutation_algorithm.scope: each final stratum independently, then concatenate binding_map entries by source_atom_id ascending
permutation_algorithm.uniqueness: source and donor atom IDs each occur exactly once within the final stratum

preserved: source lifecycle status label as a stratification attribute only
answer-token-length bin or the single declared adjacent merged bin
training examples, tokens, steps, touches, and all other envelope fields

root_compatibility.authentic: authentic evidence roots and status events remain unchanged and continue to support only authentic atoms
root_compatibility.control_projection: copy each root's public semantic projection, apply the same binding-map rewrite to all mapping-bearing fields, assign a distinct control projection digest, and require the rebound atom to agree with the rewritten projection
root_compatibility.forbidden: a control projection may not appear in an authentic status transition, support count, claim identity, or scientific truth ledger
root_compatibility.pass_condition: every rebound atom agrees with every mapping-bearing control root projection and no authentic root byte changes

stratum_key: answer_token_length_bin under the frozen tokenizer: TOK_1_2, TOK_3_4, TOK_5_8, TOK_9_16, TOK_17_PLUS

common.atom_mapping: use the registered canonical twin atom map; relation and endpoint kinds must match, source/twin atoms must be authentic at their own sealed snapshots, and all dependent path copies must be changed with their source slots
common.changed_bytes: enumerate the minimal complete set as canonical JSON pointers with before/after hashes
common.credit_rule: D0 can validate the checker only; later constructive credit requires the same intervention on an actually sealed pre-decision model state under new authority

matched_twin_state_fork.allowed_when: the non-memory public decision states do not byte-collide
matched_twin_state_fork.construction: independently replay the registered twin world and its registered action prefix to the matched decision index; take goal, public state, public outcome workspace, repeat state, remaining budgets, and authentic memory/path from that reachable twin cut
matched_twin_state_fork.forbidden: copying twin atoms into the original divergent public state, editing an original trait panel to look plausible, or retaining an original outcome/path that the replayed twin could not produce
matched_twin_state_fork.validity: simulator replay hash equals twin_cut_sha256, action count and budgets equal the replayed prefix, every changed pointer is enumerated, and every unlisted byte equals the source fork
matched_twin_state_fork.verdict: evaluate the operation against the registered valid action/set for the coherent twin state; do not interpret a source-versus-twin difference as a memory-only effect

memory_only_at_colliding_cut.allowed_when: a collision certificate proves all non-memory resolver-input bytes, public state/outcomes, repeat state, budgets, prompt bytes, snapshot-handle bytes, catalog envelope, and timing class are identical at the exact decision cut
memory_only_at_colliding_cut.required: replace every atom in the registered minimal cited cut and every dependent path copy with its type-matched authentic twin atom; cut all redundant cited paths
memory_only_at_colliding_cut.validity: the intervened resolver input is reachable in both twins at the certified cut and differs only at enumerated memory/path pointers
memory_only_at_colliding_cut.verdict: the decisive operation must become the registered twin-valid action or unordered preparation set

views.prompt_template: PCFL edge completion | subject={subject_node_token} | relation={relation} | object=
PCFL reverse edge | object={object_node_token} | relation={relation} | subject=

view_semantics.forward_completion: complete the exact object endpoint from the subject and relation
view_semantics.incident_edge_recall: return the same single full edge from a generic subject anchor without a desired relation argument
view_semantics.one_memory_statement: state only the same single edge
view_semantics.reverse_completion: complete the exact subject endpoint from the object and relation; for PREPARATION_TRANSFORM this exposes transform-template to preparation-family recognition after an explicit MODEL_DERIVED_TRANSFORM query. It is the same atom_id, not an inverse causal claim or runtime projection oracle

view_string_rules.delimiter_bytes: all spaces, vertical bars, colons, hyphens, greater-than signs, and equals signs shown in the templates are literal ASCII
view_string_rules.substitution: replace each brace token exactly once after computing node_token; braces never appear in output
